|game_text=Deploy on table. [[We Have A Prisoner]] is a Used Interrupt. TIEs are deploy +1 to [[Star Destroyer: Launch Bay{{!}}Launch Bay]]. During your deploy phase, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or retrieve) one [[Besieged (V){{!}}Besieged]] or a Launch Bay; reshuffle. Once per turn, when your Imperial captures a character, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
